{{Quote|Even the humblest of beings contains within himself a universe of infinite diversity and wonder. Therefore, when you give aid and comfort to just one being, you are, for that moment, the deity of an entire cosmos.|Gar Gratius|<ref name="Coruscant Nights I: Jedi Twilight">''[[Coruscant Nights I: Jedi Twilight]]''</ref>}}
'''Gar Gratius''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Philosopher/Legends|philosopher]] who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Nova Stihl]] studied his discourses on [[Wikipedia:Eclecticism|eclectic]] [[Wikipedia:deontology|deontology]] while stationed on the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]].
